job.job_description:
Project Role : LLM Full Stack Engineer

Project Role Description : Develop and integrate applications with Large Language Models (LLMs) and other enterprise services. Leverage front-end and server-side technologies to develop APIs, implement DevOps practices, and optimize Artificial Intelligence (AI) applications.

Must have skills : Large Language Models (LLMs)

Good to have skills : NA
Minimum 3 year(s) of experience is required

Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Summary:
As a Large Language Model Full Stack Engineer, a typical day involves designing and building applications that seamlessly integrate with advanced language models and various enterprise systems. The role requires balancing front-end and back-end development tasks, creating robust application programming interfaces, and ensuring smooth deployment through continuous integration and delivery practices. The engineer collaborates with cross-functional teams to enhance artificial intelligence solutions, focusing on performance optimization and scalability to meet evolving business needs.

Roles & Responsibilities:
- Expected to perform independently and become an SME.
- Required active participation/contribution in team discussions.
- Contribute in providing solutions to work related problems.
- Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
- Maintain and improve existing applications by identifying areas for enhancement and implementing necessary changes.
- Document development processes, code changes, and system configurations to support knowledge sharing and future maintenance.
- Assist junior team members by providing guidance and support to foster their professional growth.

Professional & Technical Skills:
- Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Large Language Models (LLMs).
- Experience with API development and integration techniques.
- Familiarity with front-end and back-end development frameworks.
- Knowledge of DevOps practices including continuous integration and deployment.
- Understanding of artificial intelligence application optimization and scalability.
- The candidate should have minimum 3 years of experience in Large Language Models (LLMs).
- This position is based at our Pune office.
- A 15 years full time education is required.

Qualification
15 years full time education
